Yes, both changes behave the way I want. Being able to correct the pre-filled title and description right there is straightforward, and the hint is reassuring without getting in the way.

The failure case also feels right: let me save the link regardless. Using the link itself as the title is a sensible fallback; I’d prefer that over forcing me to type something.

The remaining piece from this saving flow is the page’s real icon and preview image when the site provides them. I’d also want to be able to correct these details again after the bookmark has been saved, not only during the initial save.
